overview_description.description:
Elmenus is a venture-backed food discovery startup based in Egypt that serves over 1 Million monthly users. elmenus builds a platform that combines a social, visual, and personalized experience to help people discover and order the food they will love.

The company was established in 2011 and is based in Cairo, Egypt.

product.name: elmenus Online Food Discovery Platform
product.description: A digital platform providing users with access to digitized menus from over 6,000 restaurants, enabling food discovery and ordering.

product.name: elmenus Online Food Ordering Service
product.description: An automated online ordering system that enables users to place food orders, customize them, pay online, and track delivery status.

product.name: elmenus Restaurant Menu Digitization
product.description: A service that digitizes and maintains up-to-date restaurant menus for a wide range of dining establishments.

product.name: elmenus Foodie Community Platform
product.description: A community feature that allows users to share food experiences through photos and reviews within the elmenus platform.
